blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={onDelete}>`. As written the div has no role, no tabindex and no key handler: a keyboard user pressing Tab never lands on it and cannot press Enter or Space to delete the document, so the change's only task (deleting a document from its page) cannot be completed without a mouse, and a screen reader does not announce it as a button. WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable with the keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text). Its only content is `TrashIcon`, whose `<svg>` is `aria-hidden="true"` (src/components/icons.tsx:3), so even once it is a button a screen reader announces just "button", and the user cannot tell that it deletes the document. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: Add an `alt`: the owner's name (e.g. `alt={ownerName}`, passed as a prop) if the avatar is meant to say who owns the document, or `alt=""` if the owner is named in text elsewhere. Without `alt`, a screen reader reads the image's URL or file name instead of the owner. WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content.
findings.title: Owner avatar image has no alt attribute

findings.recommendation: The icon is 16x16 (src/components/icons.tsx:3) and the `icon-button` styles are not in the change. Check that the control is at least 24x24 CSS pixels or spaced accordingly, and that it shows a visible focus indicator once it is focusable. WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), 2.4.7 Focus Visible.
findings.title: Delete target size and focus style not verifiable
